title: Eval Lab viewer API revision v1
description: Response body of GET /api/v1/revision, implemented by scripts/serve_classifier_viewer.py and derived in src/eval_lab/viewer_api.py. Small and constant-size so an open viewer can poll it; it carries no chart rows and no per-record rows.

revision.description: Content hash over every artifact the viewer renders. Changes if and only if a served byte changes.

inputsRevision.description: Content hash over the upstream experiment artifacts. Pipeline visibility only; it never drives UI invalidation.
